plot-title: A shared aesthetic direction before the adjective, and an answer forecast after it
plot-caption: Out-of-fold r over 197 NTAs between the answer margin of each prompt and the J++ Lens readout projected on the shared direction: the mean judgment vector of cool, nice, fancy and pretty with the noun 'place' (left of the dotted line; each is scored by the other 3). The other prompts are held out. Circles: readout at the noun token, before the adjective. Squares: readout at the adjective token. Filled markers: a fixed yes-minus-no word score is regressed out. The temperature-to-social score is regressed out of the cool readouts. Each test layer is chosen on the fit prompts only. NTAs with no yes or no answer are left out (Gemma-4-31B ugly: 19 NTAs with place, 66 with scene).
